description.value: You gain expert proficiency in every skill you aren't already better at, and can Recall Knowledge about anything at all as a free action once per round. Signal legendary instead of expert; on a failure of any check made this way, take the damage and the Drift once, not per check.

cinderfall.incomplete: 10 minutes: expert in every skill not already better, free Recall Knowledge 1/round; Signal: legendary instead of expert, and on-failure penalties apply once total rather than per check. The proficiency-rank bump alone could reuse the same `ActiveEffectLike` `mode:"upgrade"` technique as The Whole Shelf on a companion Effect item, but 'free Recall Knowledge once per round' hands a new usable action (bucket 3) and 'take the damage/Drift once, not per check' is an aggregation rule over the unbuildable Signal/Static mechanic. The card bundles a buildable piece with two unbuildable pieces and no existing companion, so the whole card is called INCOMPLETE rather than a half-finished MIXED rules array. The class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source: `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves, so it cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check or show the player a value other than what was actually computed (`pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts`); self-inflicted reactive damage/resource cost keyed to the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home; and no `Reroll` rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/human/level-1/courteous-comeback.json` ships `rules: []`). The 0-10 Signal Drift track has the same absence as Bandwidth: no `SpecialResource`/counter representation anywhere in the corpus.
